description: This file defines a Java class 'PlatformInternalServerExceptionMapper' that implements exception mapping for 'PlatformInternalServerException' within a RESTful API, converting exceptions into a standardized JSON error response for HTTP 500 Internal Server Error.

classes.name: PlatformInternalServerExceptionMapper
classes.description: Implements exception mapping for PlatformInternalServerException, converting it into a JSON API error response with HTTP 500 status.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a PlatformInternalServerException into an HTTP Response with a JSON error message.

methods.name: errorCode
methods.description: Returns the error code identifying this exception mapper, 5001.
